crossRefs.note: Also I said, “The thing that you do is not good. Shouldn’t you walk in the fear of our God, because of the reproach of…
But the former governors who were before me were supported by the people, and took bread and wine from them, plus forty…
A revelation is within my heart about the disobedience of the wicked: “There is no fear of God before his eyes.”
By mercy and truth iniquity is atoned for. By the fear of Yahweh men depart from evil.
“There is no fear of God before their eyes.”

translations.web: how he met you by the way, and struck the rearmost of you, all who were feeble behind you, when you were faint and weary; and he didn’t fear God.
translations.bsb: how they met you on your journey when you were tired and weary, and they attacked all your stragglers; they had no fear of God.
translations.kjv: How he met thee by the way, and smote the hindmost of thee, even all that were feeble behind thee, when thou wast faint and weary; and he feared not God.
translations.asv: how he met thee by the way, and smote the hindmost of thee, all that were feeble behind thee, when thou wast faint and weary; and he feared not God.
